intro: Before is vanilla Skyrim on your own. After is our co-op setup.

grids.title: What changes in multiplayer
rows: Saving your progress
One save, reload any time
Everyone keeps their own save. The server holds no copy. Save often. Never reload while connected.
Following quests together
You talk to everyone
Keep one party leader for the whole playthrough. They handle quest dialogue, scenes and items. They enter first. Everyone fights bosses and solves puzzles.
Finishing the introduction
Helgen intro
Finish Helgen or Helgen Express offline, save outside, then connect.
Opening menus
Opening a menu pauses the game
Skyrim Souls RE keeps most menus live. Nothing pauses for the party. Get out of danger first.
Dying and respawning
Reload a save
You respawn nearby, or at the entrance indoors. No gold lost. Death may also pay your crime bounties. Not tested here.
Choosing difficulty
Your choice
Master for everyone, set by the server. Enemies do not scale with party size.
Hitting friends
No other players
Players can't hurt players. Followers and townsfolk can still be hurt.
Locking onto enemies
No target lock-on. You aim and turn yourself.
True Directional Movement adds lock-on. Our setting targets hostiles only.
Watching kill animations
On
Off.
Earning skill experience
You earn your own experience
When someone earns combat experience, everyone gets that amount. Each player's last-used combat skill gains it. Crafting experience isn't shared.
Playing with fewer friends
One save
A smaller-party night uses separate characters.
Talking to friends
No other players
Press F2 or Right Ctrl. Type, press Enter. /party and /local work.
Recruiting followers
Recruit an NPC companion to fight and carry items.
Official advice: avoid followers except for quests. They can wander.
Waiting and sleeping
Advance the clock by choosing hours to wait or sleep.
The server controls time. Waiting and sleeping cannot advance it.
Rejoining after a crash
Restart and load your latest save.
Load your latest campaign save. Reconnect. Check the usual leader. Regroup before questing. Progress recovery remains unverified.

grids.title: Skills
rows: Alchemy
Alchemist strengthens crafted potions and poisons. Snakeblood grants poison resistance.
Alchemist adds poison damage to weapon attacks. Snakeblood adds waterbreathing. Poisoner makes melee poison doses last longer.
No extra rule
Alteration
Novice through Master perks reduce spell costs. Magic Resistance provides separate magic defense.
Novice adds poison resistance. Apprentice: frost. Adept: fire. Expert: shock. Master: disease.
No extra rule
Archery
Overdraw raises bow damage. Power Shot adds stagger. Steady Hand slows time while zooming.
Overdraw adds armor penetration. Quiet Hunter perk patch gives choices: Steady Hand or Quick Draw, Power Shot or Ranger. Overdraw costs melee damage. Archery crits off while sneaking.
Choose Steady Hand or Quick Draw; taking one greys out the other. Choose Power Shot or Ranger. Sneak attacks keep Sneak multipliers.
Block
Shield Wall improves blocking. Quick Reflexes slows time while blocking a power attack.
Shield Wall becomes Iron Will, adding unarmed damage. Strong Reflexes rank 1 halves power-attack damage when shield-blocking. Rank 2 adds slowdown.
Quarantined (don't use yet): Strong Reflexes rank 2, Block 50. Rank 1, Block 30, is allowed.
Conjuration
Summoner increases casting distance. Twin Souls allows two summons. Elemental Potency strengthens atronachs. An atronach is a summoned elemental spirit.
Summoner and Puppeteer add summon slots. Twin Souls adds two. Staff of the Atronach strengthens certain spells. Potent atronachs and thralls scale with your level.
One active summon per player. Quarantined: corpse raising, Dark Souls 2 explosions. Don't use yet.
Destruction
Augmented Flames, Frost and Shock add equal damage bonuses. Rune Master increases placement range.
Augmented Flames/Frost/Shock rank 1: 20/30/40% more damage, cheaper spells. Rune Master also doubles rune capacity.
No extra rule
Enchanting
Enchanter strengthens new enchantments. Soul Siphon recharges weapons from creature kills.
Enchanter also recharges weapons from nearby kills. Corpus Enchanter strengthens additional enchantments. Soul Siphon stacks with Enchanter.
No extra rule
Heavy Armor
Juggernaut raises armor rating. Well Fitted requires head, chest, hands and feet armored.
Juggernaut adds material-specific arrow, stagger or magic protection. Well Fitted and Matching Set require three pieces. Choose any helmet.
No extra rule
Illusion
Novice Illusion reduces spell cost. Quiet Casting requires the Animage and Kindred Mage path.
Novice Illusion adds arrow avoidance. Quiet Casting: 50 Illusion or Sneak, no earlier perks. Only works while sneaking.
Enemy-control spells do not control players.
Light Armor
Agile Defender raises armor rating. Custom Fit requires head, chest, hands and feet armored.
Agile Defender adds material-specific bonuses: cheaper power attacks, stagger resistance. Custom Fit and Matching Set need only three pieces.
No extra rule
Lockpicking
Novice through Master Locks make matching locks easier to pick.
Novice through Master Locks bypass matching locks outside combat. Requires a torch. Quick Hands no longer needs earlier perks.
Quarantined (don't use yet): torch auto-unlock. Use lockpicks manually.
One-Handed
Armsman raises weapon damage. Bladesman adds sword critical hits. Hack and Slash makes axes bleed targets.
Armsman also adds critical chance. Bladesman adds bleeding. Hack and Slash boosts axe power attacks. Flurry speeds main-hand attacks.
No extra rule
Pickpocket
Light Fingers improves theft chances. Extra Pockets adds 100 carrying capacity.
Light Fingers also improves arrow recovery. Extra Pockets gains additional ranks, reaching 300 extra carrying capacity.
Coordinate theft and shared loot.
Restoration
Regeneration strengthens healing by 50%. Recovery improves Magicka regeneration.
Regeneration becomes Resurgence, strengthening Restoration by 30%. Mastery perks add Magicka regeneration. Recovery also improves Stamina regeneration.
Allowed: the held-perk lock now allows Resurgence with 10% less magicka instead of quarantined. Real healing effects on friends still need testing.
Smithing
Steel Smithing improves steel equipment. Arcane Blacksmith enables tempering enchanted equipment.
Basic Smithing also improves iron. Thalmor Smithing adds Falmer crafting. Arcane Blacksmith improves enchanted gear, leather, hide and faction armor.
No extra rule
Sneak
Backstab boosts one-handed sneak attacks. Shadow Warrior briefly breaks detection when crouching in combat.
Backstab extends bonuses to melee and spell attacks. Shadow Warrior adds night vision and greatsword sneak damage. Its second rank adds combat invisibility.
No extra rule
Speech
Haggling improves prices. Intimidation improves threatening dialogue.
Dragonborn replaces Haggling: prices, skill-books, summons, steam, drum, merchant. Intimidation also grants Battlecry.
Quarantined: Dragonborn rank 4's drum and rank 5's merchant. Don't use yet. Rank 2 keeps our one-summon limit.
Two-Handed
Barbarian raises damage. Limbsplitter makes battleaxes bleed targets. Skullcrusher ignores armor.
Barbarian adds armor penetration and greatsword bleeding. Limbsplitter boosts axe power attacks. Skullcrusher adds damage against undead.
No extra rule
grids.note: Vanilla means the unmodded game. Better Vanilla Perks is part of our collection (revision 7).

grids.title: Races
rows: High Elf
+10 Illusion. +5 Alteration, Conjuration, Destruction, Enchanting, Restoration. +50 Magicka. Highborn rapidly restores Magicka for one minute.
Level-100 skills improve. Low Magicka/Stamina recover faster but weaken defenses. Gear weakens, enchantments strengthen. Contingency stores spells for automatic casting.
No racial power in our game. Quarantined (don't use yet): Contingency. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Argonian
+10 Lockpicking. +5 Alteration, Light Armor, Pickpocket, Restoration, Sneak. Disease resistance, waterbreathing, stronger punches. Histskin rapidly restores Health.
Faster swimming, waterbreathing, post-swim stealth/speed, low-resource recovery. Caustic Spit strips armor and magic resistance. Innate disease resistance is gone.
No quarantined power. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Wood Elf
+10 Archery. +5 Alchemy, Light Armor, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Sneak. Poison/disease resistance. Command Animal temporarily recruits an animal.
Eat corpses for attributes. Harrier marks prey and weakens foes. Sense movement while still. Beast Tongue recruits animals. Loses innate poison/disease resistance.
No racial power in our game. Quarantined (don't use yet): Beast Tongue. Harrier's effects for friends and racial unlocks (not verified).
Breton
+10 Conjuration. +5 Alchemy, Alteration, Illusion, Restoration, Speech. 25% magic resistance, Conjure Familiar. Dragonskin temporarily absorbs hostile spells.
15% magic resistance, low-Magicka absorption. Special standing-stone bonuses. Grail boosts recovery. Shared Ancestry borrows human or elven racial powers.
Borrowed powers keep their quarantines. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Dark Elf
+10 Destruction. +5 Alchemy, Alteration, Illusion, Light Armor, Sneak. 50% fire resistance, Sparks. Ancestor's Wrath burns nearby enemies.
25% fire resistance. Spending Spirit Favor grants armor and further resistance. Whispers marks victims for rewards. Spirit Walk spends Favor to summon ancestors.
No racial power in our game. Quarantined (don't use yet): Spirit Walk. Whispers rewards and racial unlocks in co-op (not verified).
Imperial
+10 Restoration. +5 Block, Destruction, Enchanting, Heavy Armor, One-Handed. Imperial Luck finds gold. Voice of the Emperor calms nearby people.

Discipline boosts nearby allies' armor/damage. Random resource regeneration in combat. Permanent attribute/resistance/skill tradeoffs. Colovian Star refills and temporarily boosts Magicka and Stamina.
Discipline's benefit to players (not verified). Do not count on it as a party buff.
Khajiit
+10 Sneak. +5 Alchemy, Archery, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, One-Handed. Stronger claws. Night Eye grants repeatable night vision.
Faster movement. Sprinting costs extra Stamina. Quieter sneaking, Prowl leaps, stronger claw power attacks. Perception grants night vision and dampens sounds.
No quarantined power. Co-op movement and racial unlocks (not verified).
Nord
+10 Two-Handed. +5 Block, Light Armor, One-Handed, Smithing, Speech. 50% frost resistance. Battle Cry makes nearby enemies flee.
25% frost resistance. Choose racial enemies for damage bonuses. Missing Health strengthens attacks/spells. Avatar restores Magicka/Stamina and adds frost resistance.
No quarantined power. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Orc
+10 Heavy Armor. +5 Block, Enchanting, One-Handed, Smithing, Two-Handed. Stronghold access. Berserker Rage doubles physical damage dealt and halves damage received.
Bloodlust briefly boosts speed/recovery. Shockwave staggers. Gear strengthens but enchantments weaken. Berserk boosts attacks and reduces spell costs. May trigger randomly.
No quarantined power. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Redguard
+10 One-Handed. +5 Alteration, Archery, Block, Destruction, Smithing. 50% poison resistance. Adrenaline Rush rapidly restores Stamina.
Disease resistance replaces poison resistance. Unlimited travel Stamina, recovery when injured, kill bonuses. Red Sand Dance slows time while sprinting.
No racial power in our game. Quarantined (don't use yet): Red Sand Dance. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
grids.note: Vanilla means the unmodded game. Imperious changes racial traits. Complete racial objectives to unlock powers. High Elf, Wood Elf, Dark Elf and Redguard have no racial power in our game. Harrier, Whispers and racial progression still need testing from both sides. Prowl is a leap, not a verified teleport. Its co-op behavior is unverified. Don't count on Imperial Discipline as a party buff. Its armor and damage effects are not healing. NPCs can get racial abilities too, so avoiding a quarantined power doesn't prove all race behavior is tested.

grids.title: Spells by school
grids.note: Vanilla means the unmodded game. Mysticism changes all five spell schools. Some spells and summons use Better Vanilla Perks instead. Not tested in co-op yet. Collection revision 7.
rows: Alteration
Flesh armor, light, detection, Telekinesis and Transmute. Paralyze and Mass Paralysis belong here.

Burden slows enemies. Corrode Armor weakens armor. Feather increases carrying capacity. Sea Stride allows water-walking. Paralysis moves to Illusion. Better Vanilla Perks: Candlelight and its scroll last 120 seconds.
No named spell quarantine here. Mark and Recall belong to Conjuration.
Conjuration
Bound weapons, familiars, atronachs, Dremora and corpse raising. Dawnguard adds Soul Cairn undead summons.

Adds Skeleton summons, bound weapons and Daedric Cure for summons. Mark and Recall add Expert travel spells. Conjure Familiar keeps Mysticism's spell and wolf. Better Vanilla Perks supplies its text and look.
Quarantined (don't use yet): Mark, Recall and corpse raising. Keep one active summon per player.
Destruction
Fire, frost and shock attacks. Vampires can absorb Health using Vampiric Drain.

Burning Touch adds close-range fire. Greater Flames extends continuous attacks. Vampiric Touch, Vampiric Bolt, Blood Lance steal living enemies' Health. Flames, Frostbite and Sparks keep Mysticism's effects. Flames damages and burns; Intense Flames can cause fear. Frostbite drains health and stamina, slows, and can freeze. Sparks damages; Disintegrate can trigger.
No named spell quarantine. Exact co-op effects (not verified).
Illusion
Calm, fear, frenzy, morale, Muffle and Invisibility. Paralysis is an Alteration effect.
Paralyze moves here. Silence stops enemy casting. Command controls NPCs. Night Eye grants dark vision. Ghostwalk refreshes invisibility after it breaks.
Enemy-control spells cannot control human players. Exact co-op effects (not verified).
Restoration
Healing Hands channels healing onto NPCs. Heal Other gives an Adept burst. Grand Healing is an Expert area burst.

Heal Other becomes Apprentice. Close Greater Wounds adds Adept area healing. Grand Healing stays Expert but channels. Sunbeam damages undead. Circle of Life heals. Stendarr's Aura, Poison Rune: partly Better Vanilla Perks effects.
Ordinary healing allowed. Player healing amounts, circle effects and Resurgence bonuses (not verified).

grids.title: Quarantined perks and powers
grids.note: Quarantined means don't take, cast or use it until the host announces that its co-op test passed. These are agreed campaign rules, not an installed patch that turns the features off. Some follow old bug reports. Others cover behavior we haven't tested. A quarantine doesn't mean a crash is proven. Check Spells for spell restrictions. Can I use this? lists everything.
rows: Halves blocking damage. Melee blocks against power attacks slow time.
Quarantined (don't use yet): rank 2. Rank 1's shield protection at Block 30 is allowed.
Rank 1 slows time while zooming and adds critical chance. Rank 2 adds critical chance and protection against disarming.
Quiet Hunter perk patch lets you choose between Steady Hand and Quick Draw. Taking one greys out the other. Rank 2 remains untouched.
For 45 seconds, sprinting slows time by 90%.
Quarantined (don't use yet): this racial power.
Stores equipped spells. Casts them free when your chosen condition occurs.
Quarantined: automatic spell casting through this power. Don't use yet.
Turns the nearest carnivorous animal into an ally. Allows one animal companion.
Quarantined (don't use yet): this animal-recruiting power.
Spends two Spirit Favor. Summons two invulnerable ancestors for 45 seconds.
Quarantined even with no other summon. Don't use yet.
Summoner, Puppeteer, Twin Souls, Dragonborn rank 2 increase summon capacity.
Keep one active summon per player, regardless of unlocked capacity. Quarantined summons and corpse raising remain excluded. One summon is our starting test budget, not an engine limit.
Reanimated bodies can explode in flames when combat begins.
Quarantined (don't use yet): the perk and its corpse explosions.
Summons a spectral drum that restores followers' Stamina. Improves prices.
Quarantined (don't use yet): the drum power. Its effect on other players (not verified).
Summons a Dremora to buy and sell goods. Improves prices.
Quarantined (don't use yet): the merchant power.
Novice through Master Locks open matching locks outside combat. Requires a torch.
Quarantined (don't use yet): automatic unlocking. Use lockpicks manually.
Strengthens Restoration spells by 30%
Allowed with 10% less magicka through the held-perk lock. It is no longer quarantined. Real healing effects on friends still need testing.
Time-slowing effects
Strong Reflexes rank 2, Steady Hand and Red Sand Dance slow time for you.
Quarantined (don't use yet) for group pacing and testing. Skyrim Together can sync slow time. We don't claim all slow time breaks sync.

grids.title: While playing
rows: Arriving late
Not a thing
Join the party and regroup. Don't quest alone to catch up.
Taking a break
Pause
Type HOLD or BRB and get somewhere safe. Nothing pauses.
Saving progress
Save whenever
Save your own game before big scenes and quest turn-ins. Save when the group reaches safety.
Reporting a problem
Reload
Stop. Tell the host. Never reload while connected or fix quests alone.
Hunger and thirst
No hunger or thirst in vanilla Skyrim.
Hunger and thirst strike about every 30 real minutes. Each halves health, magicka and stamina regeneration. Food clears Hunger; a potion clears Thirst.
Fast travel
Click any discovered map marker to travel instantly.
Map fast travel is disabled. Travel on foot. Carriages and ferries should work (untested in co-op).
Vampire attacks
Vampires attack settlements as Dawnguard begins.
Night vampire attacks occur outside walled cities. None happen before level 12, and attacks are less likely at lower levels.
Job boards
Bounty letters from jarls and innkeepers.
Notice boards sit outside inns. Most jobs are miscellaneous quests. Leader takes the job, group goes; others may not see it in their journals.
grids.note: Revision 7 adds hunger and thirst about every 30 minutes, job boards outside inns, night vampire attacks outside walled cities from level 12, and no map fast travel. Our mods lists every installed mod.

grids.title: Builds
rows: Two-handed guardian
Nobody to protect
Greatsword, Heavy Armor and Block make space. Turn to protect a chased friend.
Stealth ranger
Sneak and shoot everything
Archery and Sneak find the opening. Keep moving and shooting after you're spotted.
Gandalf-style wizard
Fragile on your own
Destruction and Alteration for fire and protection, backup Restoration. Earn a staff later.
Storyteller
Talk your way through
Speech, Restoration and a weapon. Keep a reliable damage fallback.
Gravewarden
Raise the dead
Restoration first, Conjuration second. One summoned helper buys healing time.
Healer or paladin
You only heal yourself
Restoration first, plus personal defense. A paladin switches between shield, weapon and healing.

grids.title: Group play
rows: Chased
Run or fight
Say "On me". Move toward the group. The frontliner steps in.
Hurt
Drink a potion
Say "Healing here" and come within reach. Healing is not resurrection.
Dangerous caster
Deal with it yourself
Say "Caster first" and focus it. Keep a retreat route open.
Ready to move
Just go
Type or say READY.
Need help
Drink a potion or run
Type HELP and your location.
Mod settings
Yours alone
Everyone installs the same Required mods. Optional mods are your choice. Agree on changes together.
Friendly fire
No other players
Player PvP is off in our setup. Friendly NPCs can still be hit. If you use True Directional Movement, keep its hostile-only lock-on setting on.
Containers and trading
Trade directly with followers or use containers.

No shared inventory and no player-to-player trade window. Hand items over through a container while all of you are present. Containers inside player homes belong to that player alone. Containers elsewhere sync only for the current visit and can be overwritten later. Crafted potions and enchanted gear may not reach another player (untested).
Job boards
Take bounties from innkeepers.
Notice boards sit outside inns. Most jobs are miscellaneous quests. Leader takes the job, group goes; others may not see it in their journals.
Vampire attacks
Vampires attack towns at night.
Vampires attack at night outside walled cities. None occur before level 12, and attacks are less likely at lower levels.
Hunger and thirst
Food restores a small amount of health.
Hunger and thirst strike about every 30 real minutes. Each halves health, magicka and stamina regeneration. Food clears Hunger; a potion clears Thirst.

grids.title: Ownership
rows: Before you own a home
Use your pack or a container that never resets.
Keep valuables in your pack. Containers you don't own can reset.
Carried inventory
Gear and supplies travel with your character and save.
Each player carries their own items. Equipment and inventories synchronize.
World and chest loot
You collect the world's loot for yourself.
Ordinary chests and pre-placed loot are shared. Agree who takes upgrades.
Gold
You hold and spend your own gold.
Your gold stays yours. No death gold penalty. Death may also pay your crime bounties. Not tested here.
Private home chests
Owned homes provide personal storage. Choose a safe container.
A container inside a player home belongs to that player alone. Vanilla and DLC home chests are not synced to other players.
Shared storage and trading
Containers store items. Some containers reset and are unsafe for lasting storage.

No shared inventory and no player-to-player trade window. Hand items over through a container while all of you are present. Containers elsewhere sync only for the current visit and can be overwritten later. Crafted potions and enchanted gear may not reach another player (untested).
Dropped items
You can drop an item and pick it up again.
Dropped items aren't shared on our server. Trade through a tested shared chest.
Quest items
Take quest items like the Golden Claw. Advance quests yourself.
The party leader takes quest items and handles quest dialogue.
Buying a home as a non-leader
Meet the city's requirements, then pay its steward.
The leader handles prerequisite quests. Non-leader payment, keys and ownership remain unverified. Another player's purchase may not buy you a home.
Hearthfire building and furnishing
Buy a plot, gather materials and build your own house.
Vanilla/DLC interiors are personal. Building, steward purchases and party visits remain unverified.
Group base and housing
Buy or earn homes across Skyrim.
Elysium Estate is being added as the group base and may still change. Harborwatch is undecided. Containers inside homes belong to that player alone.

grids.title: Required and Optional
grids.note: How we chose the marks: we read each mod's files, Skyrim Together's code and other players' compatibility reports. We have not tested a group where some players have a mod and others do not. Read "nobody else is affected" as what the evidence says, not as something we have watched happen.
rows: Required
It changes things all players share: items, spells, perks, races, quests, spawns or weather. Or another mod needs it.
Install it. Everyone has the same Required mods.
Optional
It changes only what you see, hear or how your own menus, map and camera work.
Skip it if you like. Nobody else is affected.
Optional gear mods
Playable Greybeard Robes, Wizard Hats - Simple and Weapon Collection LotR add craftable gear.
Skipping one changes what you see on other players. They will not see your gear either. Handing gear to a player without the mod has not been tested.

grids.title: Our mods
grids.note: Vanilla means the unmodded game. Revision 7 has 32 installed mods (21 Required and 11 Optional) plus our local and Friend Kit patches.
rows: Skyrim Together Reborn
Play alone
Adds co-op connections, parties, chat and shared quests.
Required
The multiplayer client that everything else sits on.
Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE)
Standard game scripting
Adds scripting support needed by our mods.
Required
It runs every mod that ships as a plugin file, including Skyrim Together.
Address Library for SKSE Plugins
No SKSE plugin support library
Helps SKSE plugins work with the game.
Required
Skyrim Together and most of our plugin mods look up game code through it.
PapyrusUtil SE
No extra scripting helpers
A helper that QuickLoot needs for its value and weight columns.
Required
QuickLoot IE needs it, even though QuickLoot IE itself is Optional.
SkyUI
Old inventory menus
Sortable menus and the Mod Configuration menu.
Required
MCM Helper needs it, so the two fail together.
MCM Helper
Some mod menus missing
Supports mod settings in the Mod Configuration menu.
Required
The settings pages for Precision, True Directional Movement and TrueHUD need it.
TrueHUD
One health bar for your current target
Health bars over enemies and a boss bar.
Required
True Directional Movement needs it for its lock-on marker.
Helgen Express
The long Helgen intro
Quick choices for race, sign, gear, spells and helper.
Required
It changes the start of the game for every character.
Mortal Enemies
Enemies spin mid-swing
Enemies commit to swings, so you can sidestep and punish.
Required
It changes how every enemy moves. Players with different data would fight different enemies.
Precision
Fuzzy hit detection
Real weapon hitboxes. Wide swings hit several enemies. Take care around friendly NPCs.
Required
It changes how hits are detected, not only how they look. Nobody has tested a player without it.
Mysticism
Vanilla spells

rows.text: Adds spells across all five schools. Some spells use Better Vanilla Perks. See Spells by school

rows: Required
It adds hundreds of spells, effects and books that every player must share.
Better Vanilla Perks
Vanilla perk trees
Overhauls perk trees. Friend Kit patches add held-perk lock (allows Resurgence with 10% less magicka) and Quiet Hunter archery choices.
Required
It rewrites perks, spells and weapons for everyone.
Imperious
Vanilla racial bonuses

rows.text: New powers and passives for every race. See Races

rows: Required
It changes every race, and the race patch needs it.
Random Dragons No More
Dragons attack at random while you travel
Switches off the random dragon attacks. Quest dragons stay.
Required
It only works if the party leader's game has it, and anyone can lead.
Cathedral Weathers and Seasons
Vanilla weather
Replaces weather, fog and thunder, and makes nights darker.
Required
The party leader's weather is what everyone sees. The Sounds of Skyrim patch needs it.
Disable Fast Travel
Clicking a map marker instantly travels there.
Switches off map fast travel. Carriages and ferries should work (untested in co-op).
Required
Keeps travel on foot together in co-op.
Keyword Item Distributor
No keyword distribution helper.
Distributes keywords to food and drink items without changing game records.
Required
Simplest Survival needs it to identify food and drinks.
Simplest Survival
No hunger or thirst in vanilla Skyrim.
Adds hunger and thirst. Each halves health, magicka and stamina regeneration. Food clears Hunger; a potion clears Thirst.
Required
Everyone needs the same survival rules and timing.
Simplest Survival - Needs 30 Minutes Patch
No hunger or thirst.
Hunger and thirst each arrive about every 30 real minutes (10 game hours at timescale 20).
Required
Spaces survival needs to fit group pacing.
The Notice Board
Bounty letters from innkeepers and jarls.
Adds job boards outside inns. Most jobs are miscellaneous quests. Leader takes the job, group goes; others may not see it in their journals.
Required
Adds physical job boards outside inns in the shared world.
Vampire Attacks Restored Outside of Walled Cities
Vampires attack settlements as Dawnguard begins.
Restores night attacks outside walled cities. Our gentle-start patch sets attacks from level 12 onward, less likely at lower levels.
Required
Changes NPC spawns in the shared world. Gentle-start patch is installed with it.
Skyrim Souls RE
Menus pause the game
Menus stay open during play. Enemies can still hit you.
Optional
Menus only. Skip it and your inventory, map and magic menus behave as they do without the mod. Nobody else is affected.
SSE Display Tweaks
60 FPS, cursor escapes
Borderless window, higher frame rates, cursor stays in the game.
Optional
Display only. Skip it and you do not get the borderless window or the frame and physics settings. Nobody else is affected.
Better Third Person Selection
Aim the tiny crosshair
Walk up. Press E on what's highlighted.
Optional
Interaction only. Skip it and in third person you must aim straight at an object, door or container to use it.
True Directional Movement
Manual turning
Move freely. Press middle mouse to lock onto hostiles. Scroll to switch targets.
Optional

Camera and movement only. Skip it and you move and lock on as normal Skyrim does, with no lock-on marker. If you install it, keep its hostile-only targeting setting on. TrueHUD stays installed either way.
QuickLoot IE
Open every container
Chests and bodies show loot. Press E for one item. Press R for all.
Optional
Looting only. Skip it and you open containers and bodies with the normal menu.
moreHUD
Guess what you know
Shows known enchantments, read books, value and weight.
Optional
Information only. Skip it and you do not see extra details when you look at items.
Atlas Map Markers
Sparse map
Hundreds of extra map markers.
Optional
Map only. Skip it and your map shows only the vanilla markers.
Vanilla ambient sound
Adds ambient sound in the wild, in caves, in ruins and at night. It comes with a patch for Cathedral Weathers.
Optional

Sound only. Skip it and you do not hear the added ambient sounds. The patch comes with this mod, so skipping the mod skips the patch too. Cathedral Weathers stays installed either way, because it is Required.
Playable Greybeard Robes
No craftable Greybeard clothing
Craftable Greybeard clothing.
Optional
Skip it and you will not see this clothing on players who have it, and they will not see yours. Handing it to a player without the mod has not been tested.
Wizard Hats - Simple
No craftable wizard hats
22 craftable hats.
Optional
Skip it and you will not see the hats on players who have them, and they will not see yours. Handing a hat to a player without the mod has not been tested.
Weapon Collection LotR
No craftable Lord of the Rings weapons
26 craftable weapons.
Optional
Skip it and you will not see these weapons on players who have them, and they will not see yours. Handing a weapon to a player without the mod has not been tested.
